name: pr-federal-residence-and-filing
description: Puerto Rico federal residence and filing reference for the 2025 tax year, checked against federal law and the IRS territory guide. Separates presence, tax home and closer connection from income sourcing and the federal exclusion. Covers alternative presence tests for US citizens and resident aliens, federal-government wages, departure exceptions and change-of-residence reporting. Explains why local registration or an incentive decree does not establish the federal tests. Includes a practical evidence checklist without promising a blanket tax exemption. Local personal tax calculations, investment sourcing, military exceptions and independent accountant review remain outside this initial draft.
